name: OKX Trading
description: Build your own OKX perpetual swap trading dashboard

market.ticker.label: Real-time Price
market.ticker.description: Live price, 24h change, high/low, volume. Updates every 5 s.

market.candles.label: Candlestick Chart
market.candles.description: Multi-timeframe K-line chart with crosshair and volume. Powered by lightweight-charts.

account.balance.label: Account Balance
account.balance.description: Total equity, available margin, currency breakdown. Updates every 60 s.

trading.positions.label: Position Management
trading.positions.description: Open perpetual positions with unrealized P&L, liquidation price, and one-click close/reduce.

trading.orders.label: Place Orders
trading.orders.description: Market/limit/post-only orders with leverage, SL/TP, and AI-assisted sizing.

defaultLever.label: Default Leverage
defaultLever.description: Pre-filled leverage when the panel opens

trading.open-orders.label: Open Orders
trading.open-orders.description: Pending orders with live status, cancel, and amend. Updates every 10 s.

analysis.technical.label: Technical Analysis
analysis.technical.description: Multi-timeframe indicators: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, StochRSI, ADX, Support/Resistance.

analysis.ai-assess.label: AI Market Assessment
analysis.ai-assess.description: Claude reads the technical signals and gives a structured trade assessment with confidence score.

analysis.position-track.label: Position Tracking
analysis.position-track.description: AI monitors open positions and proactively suggests SL/TP adjustments as market moves.

review.history.label: Order History
review.history.description: Closed trades with entry/exit price, P&L, fees, and duration.

review.postmortem.label: Trade Postmortem
review.postmortem.description: AI reviews past trades with chart replay context and suggests what to improve.

stages.label: Watch the Market
stages.hint: Start by observing price action and getting familiar with the data

stages.label: Read the Signals
stages.hint: Add technical analysis to understand what the indicators are telling you

stages.label: Start Trading
stages.hint: Place your first trade with proper risk management

stages.label: Optimize & Review
stages.hint: Use AI insights and trade reviews to improve your strategy
